en: Dependent on a state that is not fixed, a state that is not fixed arises by way of root condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is not not-fixed, a state that is not not-fixed arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is both not fixed and not not-fixed, a state that is not fixed arises by way of root condition … one. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are five; in the object condition, two ... pe ... in the ripening condition, one ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, five.
